text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Run, run away...! From who I used to 
be...! From the old meee!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Empty your mind and just do it. 
Hyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mejiro it is, but it's Palmer! It's 
Palmer! She crosses the finish line in 
first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything she had, Mejiro 
Palmer achieved a brilliant victory in the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze, gasp*...! I won~. 
Even if it was ugly. Even if all I could 
do was run recklessly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Palmer. How should I put 
it... You're really just, Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Did something change? She seems so 
serious... or should I say, kind of 
terrifying?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Scared?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. You never made such a stern face 
when we were kids, did you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the reason I was able to run 
so well on this grand stage is because 
I've changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, maybe. Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Sorry, it's not that I've changed or 
anything. It's just that~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I just couldn't show my true self for the 
longest time. And now, at last, just a 
little bit...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer! I managed to pull it 
off! I can't believe I'm a Satsuki Sho 
winner!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad I ran. I decided to enter on my 
own, ran the race... and now, this!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a fantastic result!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still~, I might not have changed how 
people see Ryan all that much. It's tough 
to shake the 'good girl' label, you know?
choice_data_list:
Still, I bet it made them aware of you, 
didn't it?

Still, I bet it made them aware of you, 
didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I felt like Ryan's eyes changed for 
a second. Like, 'Not bad, kid.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I gotta become able to convey them way 
more! ――My vibes, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A scene from childhood. A sepia-toned 
memory etched into the mind: "Mejiro 
Palmer is a good girl."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though, today, through a 
hard-fought victory, Mejiro Palmer had 
managed to change that color just a little 
bit.
